question:
The following piie chart shows the expenditure of Ayush on various heads, including Savings, as percentages of his income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fa1ebdd5e80c940bab71ce56d1234265ecafd42c4b1b011aa6d04934522fc6c.png] 

If the expenditure of Ayush on Food is Rs. 18,000, then what would his savings be?
solution:
Calculation:

15% of the pie chart represents Rs. 18000.

So, 100% of the pie chart represents = 18000/15 × 100 = Rs. 1,20,000

Now, his savings = 120000 × 23% = Rs. 27600

**∴ His savings would be Rs. 27600.**
